WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT zoneref, traitcount FROM scanfeatures
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(traitcount) as total_traits FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.zoneref,
    s1.traitcount,
    CAST(s1.traitcount AS REAL) / s2.total_traits as ratio
  FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
  WHERE s2.total_traits IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3
)
SELECT 
  s3.zoneref,
  s3.traitcount,
  s3.ratio,
  s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as diff
FROM step3 s3, step4 s4
WHERE s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
  AND s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10
